notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
